name: Steam client
author: Cell
summary: Smooth trackpad scrolling and Windows 10 mode for the Steam client, so the store, library and chat feel native.
useWhen: Steam's window is black or blank, or Steam keeps restarting itself.

notes: Typing Chinese, Japanese or Korean in Steam needs the container language set to that language. Automatic does this when such an input method is enabled on your Mac.
If the in-game overlay won't open, use “Open Steam Friends” in Cell's menu bar item to invite friends from the friends list instead.

diagnostics.title: Steam's web view crashed
diagnostics.advice: Keep “Fix Steam's black or blank window” on in the container's Steam settings, then quit and reopen Steam from Cell.
